answer: Put time-weighted average stake proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 729 pays 10935 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the ferrous up to the light, weigh the crystal of the attack, and keep the zephyr of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
